name: Clear Jam
body:
School transmutation; Level ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target 1 jammed firearm
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Any barrel jams in the target firearm are cleared. The firearm is loaded and ready to be fired. This spell has no effect on a weapon that is not jammed (see the jammed optional rule or the spell rifle jam).
